headline: Congress named a Plattsburgh, New York post office building after Ross Bouyea.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 10 Miller Street in Plattsburgh, New York, as the "Ross Bouyea Post Office Building." It is a naming law only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 21, 2018.
